name: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 (Strix Point, dual-channel LPDDR5X)
memory_bandwidth_basis: LPDDR5X-7500 x 128-bit = ~120 GB/s theoretical peak; ~90-100 GB/s effective
notes: The desktop-CPU trap for local LLM inference: a fast modern APU on a dual-channel LPDDR5X bus delivers only ~120 GB/s - ~4x less than 12-channel EPYC Genoa (460.8) and ~7x less than Mac Studio Ultra (800-819). Measured 3.5 tok/s on Qwen2.5-32B Q4 (llama.cpp discussion #19480). Soldered LPDDR5X caps capacity at 32-96 GB. Fine for 7-13B; do not buy for 32B+ dense decode - more cores do not help because decode is bandwidth-bound.
